title: Digital Transformation for a Brandenburg Construction Firm
excerpt: How we replaced an outdated website with a modern, AI-enhanced platform for Markische Projekt Bau -- a construction company with 25+ years of experience across commercial, residential, and institutional building.
challenge: Markische Projekt Bau GmbH, established in 1999, had an outdated website that didn't reflect their track record of delivering complex construction projects across Berlin and Brandenburg. They needed a multilingual digital presence that could showcase their portfolio, support lead generation, and serve their diverse workforce.
solution: We built a Next.js platform with a dynamic project gallery featuring 10+ completed builds, integrated an AI-powered chatbot using Google Gemini 2.5 Flash for instant visitor queries, and implemented 8-language support to serve their international workforce. The site includes automated content workflows via email-to-issue pipelines.

testimonial.quote: Sebastian built and continues to manage our website, providing reliable support for several years. His consistent quality and dependability have been essential for our online presence.
testimonial.author: S. Kundoch
